steps.meaning: The number of usable blood units physically held in St. Vincent regional hospital's blood bank at the deadline of Friday, 24 July 2026, 12:00:00 Pacific Daylight Time.
steps.name: hospital_inventory_at_deadline

steps.meaning: St. Vincent regional hospital held 15 usable units at 9:00 AM on Monday 20 July 2026.
steps.name: initial_inventory

steps.meaning: The Tuesday shipment of 150 units from the centre is received into the hospital bank. The shipment departs at 4:00 PM Tuesday and arrives about 3 hours later, so by 7:00 PM Tuesday, well before the deadline.
steps.name: tuesday_shipment_received

steps.meaning: The centre dispatches 150 units on Tuesday 21 July 2026 at 4:00 PM Pacific.
steps.name: tuesday_shipment_dispatched

steps.meaning: The centre has at least 150 usable units in stock at 4:00 PM Tuesday to dispatch. The centre's inventory is the sum of initial stock (40 units at Monday 9 AM) plus collections from Monday and Tuesday up to 4:00 PM Tuesday.
steps.name: centre_has_stock_tuesday

steps.meaning: The centre held 40 usable units at 9:00 AM Monday 20 July 2026.
steps.name: centre_initial_stock

steps.meaning: The mobile collection drive operates on Monday 20 July from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, collecting at 12 units per hour, yielding 96 units.
steps.name: monday_collection

steps.meaning: The mobile collection drive operates on Tuesday 21 July from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM (since dispatch is at 4:00 PM, collections up to that time are available), collecting at 12 units per hour for 7 hours, yielding 84 units.
steps.name: tuesday_collection_before_4pm

steps.meaning: The Thursday shipment of 150 units from the centre is received into the hospital bank. The shipment departs at 4:00 PM Thursday and arrives about 3 hours later, so by 7:00 PM Thursday, well before the deadline.
steps.name: thursday_shipment_received

steps.meaning: The centre dispatches 150 units on Thursday 23 July 2026 at 4:00 PM Pacific.
steps.name: thursday_shipment_dispatched

steps.meaning: The centre has at least 150 usable units in stock at 4:00 PM Thursday to dispatch. The centre's inventory is the sum of initial stock (40) plus all collections Monday through Thursday up to 4:00 PM Thursday, minus the 150 units shipped Tuesday.
steps.name: centre_has_stock_thursday

steps.meaning: The mobile collection drive operates on Wednesday 22 July from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, collecting at 12 units per hour, yielding 96 units.
steps.name: wednesday_collection

steps.meaning: The mobile collection drive operates on Thursday 23 July from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM (since dispatch is at 4:00 PM, collections up to that time are available), collecting at 12 units per hour for 7 hours, yielding 84 units.
steps.name: thursday_collection_before_4pm
